definitions.full: H5772. ownah [ עוֺנָה ] Qr, [ עֵינָה ] Kt noun feminine only suffix Hosea 10:10 : Qr plural עוֺנֹתָם Baer, singular עוֺנָתָם Ginsb; > עֵינֹתָם Kt; but read עֲוֺנֹתָם , see עָוֺן 1a. . [ עֹנָה ] noun feminine cohabitation (Late Hebrew עוֺנָה time , also = Biblical Hebrew; possibly response or correspondence, commerce , from above √; or else euphemistic, specific time , SS (compare Ba ES 17 , from √ ); Thes from עון dwell); — suffix עֹנָתָהּ Exod 21:10 (E) i.e. her marriage rights. — Hosea 10:10 see עָוֺן
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root apparently meaning to dwell together;
